::: {.recipe-meta}
**Serves:** 8–10\
**Prep time:** 10 minutes\
**Cook time:** 1 hour

[Dessert]{.badge .badge-dessert} [Vegetarian]{.badge .badge-vegetarian}
:::

*Dense and melt-in-your-mouth.*

## Ingredients

- 3 cups sugar
- 6 eggs
- 2 sticks butter
- 1 cup sour cream
- 3 cups flour
- ¼ tsp baking powder
- 1½ tsp vanilla extract

## Instructions

*Preheat the oven to 325°F.*

1. Mix all the ingredients together.
2. Add mixture to a baking pan.
3. Bake for 1 hour.
